basic_profile.bio: Originally from Delhi, I'm a 34-year-old digital marketing strategist currently living in Boston. I have a deep interest in storytelling and improvisational comedy, which led me to follow podcasts like Harmontown religiously. In my free time, I enjoy exploring music scenes—particularly live performances—and engage in tabletop RPGs. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy spending evenings discussing various topics with my partner. My typical online hours are late evenings, mostly after work and dinner. I dislike negativity and unnecessary drama online and prefer constructive or humorous interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Mass Communication and a master's in Digital Marketing. My knowledge is primarily self-taught through years of experience working with various tech startups and agencies. I stay updated with industry trends through online courses and forums.
